'''March 2000 Thunder Bay tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Thunder Bay, Ontario in March 2000. Kris won it. It is known from Derek Tessier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d760">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-18-thunder-bay-ontario-mar-00d760/ thunder-bay-ontario-mar-00], DeckTech (Derek "UnknownGlyph" Tessier, 18 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-18-thunder-bay-ontario-mar-00d760/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' March 2000
* '''Site:''' Thunder Bay, Ontario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 6
* '''Winner:''' Kris
